# A02-S10: Residency terms

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Thank you for your elaboration of the format. I was not aware that it was a residency structure. In my presentation, I will present the initiatives that I would be able to carry out to promote MindFuture and create activity in the center over a period of half a year.




If this is a residency supporting ‘my’ artwork to put
MindFuture on the agenda, then it is another format. First of all, the
physical events would not be necessary (they were mostly for your sake,
and therefore also outside the budget), and the time would in that case be better
spent making the work as good as possible and focusing intensively on the
public communication. I can arrange that myself, and then
transport is also not much of an issue, as it would be a
digital residency where I exhibit on MindFuture’s media as well as in
the press. Possible future events would depend on the success of the work and be within the
reception period, so that is a later discussion.

As a vain artistic researcher, I have to point out[████] My work is
awarded by the Danish Arts Foundation, I have broad exhibition experience at
recognized places, have led several artistic development collaborations and
have a large international network with leading technology thinkers. My
qualifications have the same value and will open you to a whole different audience
;-)

However, I fully understand the overall point. I look forward to
talking more tomorrow :-)
